 "claim": "q05 at 1 CN runs at the memory ceiling: the GPU pool high-water mark climbs from 0.61 GiB to 63.58 GiB 0.9 s into the cold run, 99.01 GiB at the end of q05.r0 and exactly 100.00 GiB (the pool cap) at the end of q05.r1's fused fragment; the host pool high-water jumps from 71 MB to 106.96 GB during that same fragment (108.3 GB by q05.r2), against a whole-day host high-water of 34.0 GB on the same box yesterday.   "/tmp/claude-1002/-home-prestouser-aocsa-sirius/25f3e903-c551-4a98-b7fc-a6e0ed53ade6/scratchpad/perf/sf1000/cn1/engine-.cn0.log (host_pool peak max 33991688192)",
  "/tmp/claude-1002/-home-prestouser-aocsa-sirius/25f3e903-c551-4a98-b7fc-a6e0ed53ade6/scratchpad/demoplus/arms/dp-cn1-six/quent/.cn0/01a06e73-0467-7362-842f-7129cc6a3fbc/{memory,memory_tier,gpu_device,engine,channel} (0 bytes each)",
  "/tmp/claude-1002/-home-prestouser-aocsa-sirius/25f3e903-c551-4a98-b7fc-a6e0ed53ade6/scratchpad/perf/sf1000/capture-cn.sh:11 (GPU_MEM=100GiB HOST_MEM=160GiB STAGING=16GiB)"
 ],
